sources.entry: Notchly - Lightweight native macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into an interactive space for music controls, battery states, gestures, and custom HUDs.

summary.one_liner: Notchly is a lightweight native macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a compact interactive control surface for music, battery status, gestures, and Codex AI alerts.
summary.what_it_does: Notchly adds controls around the MacBook notch, including music playback controls for Spotify, Apple Music, and other supported media sources. It shows battery and charging indicators with a configurable low-battery threshold, and offers lock screen music controls. It includes focus mode animations, swipe gestures, and multi-display behavior tied to the primary screen. It can also show alerts for Codex sessions (approval requests and task completion) when enabled in its settings and paired with a local Stop hook in Codex. The README says it is local-first with no personal data collection.
use_cases: Control music playback from the notch
Check battery and charging status at a glance
Get Codex approval and task completion alerts
Add lock screen music controls on macOS
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG from Releases
Open the DMG and move Notchly to Applications
Launch Notchly and grant Automation permission if using Spotify or Apple Music controls
Build from source: git clone git@github.com:Notchly/Notchly.git && cd Notchly && open Notchly.xcodeproj
Or build from the command line: xcodebuild -project Notchly.xcodeproj -scheme Notchly -configuration Debug build
notable: Turns the MacBook notch into a music, battery, and alert display
Codex AI alerts for approval and task completion events via a local Stop hook
Works with Spotify and Apple Music via Automation permission
Lightweight native macOS app with auto-updates through Sparkle
MIT licensed and local-first with no personal data collection stated
caveats: Spotify and Apple Music controls need macOS Automation permission
Codex alerts require enabling settings and restarting Codex
